name: fix-pos-table-merge-feedback
title: Fix false POS table merge errors and missing split feedback
description: Keep successful merge/split mutations independent from all table-list refresh side effects and show accurate POS notifications.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Follow-up reproduction shows the native POS failure alert still fires after a successful GraphQL merge. The remaining post-mutation path is the hook-owned refetch call. Calling refetch can throw synchronously before Promise.catch is attached, so the shared merge wrapper still rejects after the backend commit. Remove redundant hook-owned refresh; all real UI callers already refresh after success.
